name: app-money-mindfulness-app-in-warm-rust-with-topographic-lines-and-feeling-chips
title: Three rust and peach screens: blurred welcome, 'Every purchase has a story' home, and a feeling-chip picker, with topographic line texture
whatItIs: Three phones on peach: a blurred portrait welcome 'Feel better about money and the choices you make.' with topographic lines and a Begin Now button; a home with a rust header, an orange Explore your habits tab, small step cards and recent purchases with a pill nav; and a screen 'Name your feelings.' with peach pills, a few coloured and tilted (Calm, Guilt, Disappointed) and an orange Continue button.
whatItMeans: Warm and reflective; earthy rust and topographic lines make money feel human.
techniques: Use topographic contour lines as texture.
Show emotion words as tilted chips.
Notch the header to hold a tab.
Keep to rust, peach and orange.

vocabulary.definition: A header with a cut-out holding a tab.
